latest_release.name: Optimizer
latest_release.body:
## [17.0] - 2026-11-12
- New: Complete visual redesign with a modern Fluent look
- New: Theme engine with dark and light modes and accent color support
- New: Modern typography
- New: Startup items redesigned as cards with search, filtering
- New: Startup items now show and toggle their Task Manager enabled/disabled state
- New: Modern Apps are now listed and removed via the WinRT PackageManager API
- New: Disk Activity tool
- Improved: Apps feed links updated, discontinued apps removed
- Improved: Newtonsoft.Json updated to 13.0.4
- Removed: Safe-mode Defender disable/enable scripts (`/disabledefender`, `/restart=disabledefender`, `/restart=enabledefender`, "Restart & Disable Defender" button and `DisableDefender`/`EnableDefender` template restart types), because they caused issues with Windows Security

detail.readme:
ℹ️ Advanced Privacy and Security Configuration Utility

Welcome to Optimizer, an advanced configuration utility designed to enhance your privacy and security on Windows. This tool is highly recommended for use after a fresh installation of Windows to achieve maximum privacy and security benefits. Depending on your Windows version, Optimizer can also help you apply specific system tweaks.

🏗️ Key Features:

- Full multilingual support (24 languages available) - Enhance system and network performance - Disable unnecessary Windows services - Turn off Windows telemetry, Cortana, and more - Disable Office telemetry (works with Office 2016 or newer) - Stop automatic Windows 10/11 updates - Download multiple useful apps quickly - Disable CoPilot AI in Windows 11 & Edge - Enable UTC time globally - Advanced tweaks like disabling HPET, OneDrive, etc. - Uninstall UWP apps - Clean system drive and browser profiles - Fix common registry issues - Ping IPs and assess latency - Search IPs on SHODAN.io - Quickly change DNS server (from a pre-made list) - Flush DNS cache - Remove unwanted startup programs - Edit your HOSTS file - Edit your System Variables paths - Monitor your disk activity - Identify and terminate file lock handles - Hardware inspection tool - Add items to the desktop right-click menu - Define custom commands for the run dialog - Support silent runs using a template file

⬇️ Downloads

Find the latest release of Optimizer on the [Releases](https://github.com/hellzerg/optimizer/releases) page.

🖼️ Screenshots

View Optimizer in action through our [Screenshots](https://github.com/hellzerg/optimizer/blob/master/IMAGES.md) collection.

🔨 Automation using Templating

Explore the possibilities of automation with Optimizer through our [Automation Guide](https://github.com/hellzerg/optimizer/blob/master/AUTOMATION.md).

🔨 Command-line Options

Check out the [Command-line Options](https://github.com/hellzerg/optimizer/blob/master/CONFS.md) available for Optimizer.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common queries in the [FAQ Section](https://github.com/hellzerg/optimizer/blob/master/FAQ.md).

📰 Changelog

Stay updated with the latest changes through the [Changelog](https://github.com/hellzerg/optimizer/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md).

🛡️ Security Policy

Learn about our security measures in the [Security Policy](https://github.com/hellzerg/optimizer/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

💻 Compatibility

- Requires .NET Framework 4.8 - Compatible with Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10, 11 - Can run on Windows Server 2008, 2012, 2016, 2019, 2022 using `/unsafe` switch

📊 Details

- Latest version: 17.0 (Released: November 12, 2026) - SHA256: EEB367F0B8C651C10934D985BFA53A94CA56F7C6BFF39A44D9BD944514A6DAFB
